We need to compare laptop quotations (RFQ-2026-014) and determine which vendor offers the fastest delivery. We have multiple vendor quotes: Acme, BrightPath, Nimbus, Orbital. We need to extract delivery lead times.

From Acme: "Delivery lead time: 14 business days from purchase order".

BrightPath: "Delivery lead time: 21 calendar days from purchase order".

Nimbus: "Delivery 7 business days." (from Nimbus Tech Supply quote). That is 7 business days.

Orbital: "lead_time: 10 business days".

Thus fastest is Nimbus with 7 business days. We need to output "Fastest delivery: Nimbus Tech Supply" or vendor name. The vendor name is Nimbus Tech Supply. So final answer: "Fastest delivery: Nimbus Tech Supply".
